description: Implementation of IP-in-IP tunneling interface for Zephyr OS, including functions for interface initialization, start/stop, packet sending/receiving, configuration, and management of IP tunneling contexts.

methods.name: iface_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPIP interface, sets flags, and marks initialization as done.

methods.name: get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the virtual IPIP interface.

methods.name: interface_start
methods.description: Starts the IPIP interface if not already started.

methods.name: interface_stop
methods.description: Stops the IPIP interface if it is running.

methods.name: ipv4_get_tos
methods.description: Retrieves the Type of Service (TOS) field from an IPv4 packet.

methods.name: interface_send
methods.description: Handles sending packets through the IPIP tunnel, adding appropriate IP headers for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: interface_recv
methods.description: Handles receiving packets on the IPIP tunnel.

methods.name: verify_remote_addr
methods.description: Verifies if the remote address matches the tunnel's peer address.

methods.name: interface_input
methods.description: Processes incoming packets, verifies remote address, and routes to the correct interface.

methods.name: interface_attach
methods.description: Attaches a lower interface to the IPIP tunnel and configures IPv6 address if needed.

methods.name: interface_set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the virtual interface, such as peer address and MTU.

methods.name: interface_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters of the virtual interface.
